string.text: Callback monitoring, performance profiling, and testing.
Log top-firing callbacks at regular intervals.
[seconds]\nHow often to log periodic statistics. Range 10-3600.
Log callback arguments/parameters. Can create large log files.
Extract detailed info from objects (type, name, section, community).
Maximum depth for table introspection (1-4). Higher = more detail but larger logs.
Scan smart terrain distances, stash density, base spacing, and feature distribution per level. Fires on level load and periodically. Log output: logs/testzone.log

For when every timer in the game stops at once: HUDs never appear, stat panels freeze, and nothing is logged. Records whether the timer queue registered at load and which timer broke it. After a freeze, run_string tz_watcher.log_queue_state() names the timer left mid-call. Takes effect on the next game load. Log output: logs/testzone.log
Limit log frequency per callback type. Prevents log spam from high-frequency callbacks.
[milliseconds]\nMinimum time between logs for same callback type. Range 100-10000.
Periodic scan of all mutant squads. Logs species, faction, online/offline, smart terrain, commander fields.
[seconds]\nHow often the mutant scan runs. Range 5-300.
Periodic scan of the current level: squads, smart terrains, stashes, and the AP squad overlay.
[seconds]\nHow often the level scan runs. Range 10-300.
World-wide squad census: totals by faction, by level, and online/offline counts.
[seconds]\nHow often the world scan runs. Range 30-600.
Watcher logs all 162 engine callbacks. Log output: logs/testzone.log
Wraps suspect GAMMA mod functions with timing to measure actual frame cost.
Start recording timing data for wrapped functions. Functions are always wrapped, this controls measurement.
[seconds]\nHow often to log profiler report. Range 10-300.
[microseconds]\nSingle call exceeding this value counts as a spike. Range 100-10000.
Profiler wraps 22 suspect functions identified from GAMMA review. Log output: logs/testzone.log
What the stalkers and mutants near you hear, see, remember, take as danger and pick as enemy. One line per change. Output: logs/testzone_perception.log
Every hearing event that reaches him, with its power against his threshold. One line per source and sound type per half second.
When he starts or stops seeing you, and his detection progress in 10 percent steps.
His visual, sound and hit memory of you: presence, age and payload, on every change. Mutants: visual only.
His held danger with the action answering it down to the leaf (take cover, look out, hold, detour, search), and his reaction with the distance he moved. Stalkers only.
Who he picks as enemy and drops, and whether this log saw him hear or see you before the pick.
Subjects within this distance of you are tracked (meters).
Hearing events from every source, not only yours. One line per subject and source per second at most.
Track mutants as well as stalkers. Every line carries the kind.
Reads engine state only. Works the same with any AI mod on or off, so two runs compare. Log output: logs/testzone_perception.log
GeoTool saves marks, notes and recorded samples per spot to logs/geo_tool.txt. The open key shows the window, and the HUD shows the live readings.
Opens the GeoTool window. Esc closes it.
[seconds] While Record is on, one SAMPLE line per interval with your marks and every reading.
Where the readings HUD sits. Off hides it.
[seconds] How often the HUD and the open window read every check.
Show this reading on the HUD. The nearest smart terrain, its distance, and whether it is a base or a lair.
Show this reading on the HUD. The nearest trader, medic or mechanic within 80 m, and its faction.
Show this reading on the HUD. The xlibs indoor test: a roof within 4 m and at least two walls within 5 m.
Show this reading on the HUD. The raw roof distance and wall count behind the xlibs indoor test.
Show this reading on the HUD. A roof within 4 m from an up ray, or a down ray from above when the roof only blocks from one side; walls are ignored.
Show this reading on the HUD. Whether the level counts as underground.
Show this reading on the HUD. Whether the emission treats your spot as cover.
Show this reading on the HUD. Whether the game flags you as in a safe shelter.
Show this reading on the HUD. How much rain reaches you.
A reading whose mark you set in the window turns faint green when it agrees and faded red when not. Records go to logs/geo_tool.txt, one tab-separated line each.
Logging level and flush for every TestZone subsystem. Output: logs/testzone.log
Minimum severity written to the log. DEBUG shows everything, ERROR almost nothing.
Write each line to disk at once instead of buffering. Slower, but the log stays current while you tail it.
Restore all TestZone MCM settings to defaults. Use after upgrading from a version with a different MCM structure.
Warning: save or discard pending MCM changes first, otherwise they override the reset on the next Accept.
TestZone: all settings restored to defaults.

GeoTool shows what the game's place checks say at your spot. A wrong check stands out against what you know is true.

The HUD shows the live readings. MCM, TestZone, GeoTool sets its position and its rows, and Off hides it.

Marks hold what you know about this spot. Set each one to yes or no, or leave it unset when you have not checked. A reading turns green when it agrees with its mark and red when it does not.

Note saves the spot with every reading and your typed text, and an empty note saves the spot alone. Record saves one sample per interval until you press Stop. Turn it on and walk a route.

Every record goes to logs/geo_tool.txt as one line with the time, kind, level, position, level vertex, marks and readings.

Del opens the window, and MCM can change that key. Esc closes it, and a running recording keeps going.

AnimationTool plays a motion or a state on a stalker. You judge it and log it as good or bad.

Look at a stalker and press Home to bind him. Select keeps him bound when you reopen the tool. Reset clears that.

The list shows every .tsv or .txt file in configs/testzone/anim. Click a file, then click a motion to select it. Play or a double click plays it, and Stop sends the stalker back to idle.

Two arrows on the left switch between pose and moving. The other two step to the previous or next motion and play it. A prop from the prop row, a bottle or a guitar, attaches from the next play on.

Good and bad log the selected motion with any typed note. Note logs the typed note alone. Everything goes to the anim curation file in the logs folder.

A motion plays only when that stalker has its animation file loaded. Esc closes the tool.
